name: submit-code
description: Manually submit a Notion verification code into the ALREADY-OPEN signup tab. Use this when notion/signup detected the code email but could not read the code from the subject line (Notion puts it in the email body — get it from the forwarded mailbox, remember to check Junk). Finds the Notion tab, focuses it, fills the code, clicks Continue, waits for the redirect, and captures the session cookies — the same finish as signup's tail. Does NOT clear cookies or re-request a code.

steps.function: (args) => { const tabs = args.tabs || []; const t = tabs.find(x => /app\.notion\.com\/[^\/]*(signup|login)/i.test(x.url || '')) || tabs.find(x => /app\.notion\.com/.test(x.url || '')); return t ? { ok: true, tabId: t.id, url: t.url } : { ok: false, error: 'No Notion tab found — keep the signup tab open (or open app.notion.com) and re-run' }; }
const btns = document.querySelectorAll('div[role="button"]'); for (const b of btns) { if (b.innerText.trim() === 'Continue') { b.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false };

return new Promise((resolve) => { const check = () => { const url = window.location.href; if (url.includes('/onboarding') || (url.includes('app.notion.com') && !url.includes('/signup') && !url.includes('/login'))) { resolve({ redirected: true, url }); return; } setTimeout(check, 1000); }; check(); });

(args) => { const cookies = args.cookies || []; const map = {}; for (const c of cookies) map[c.name] = c.value; return { userId: map.notion_user_id || '', tokenV2: map.token_v2 || '', deviceId: map.notion_device_id || '' }; }

steps.message: 🎉 Code submitted — session captured. Continue with create-workspace / full-onboarding steps as needed.
